ordered_operations: prove the nonattacking activation is rejected without state change
activate Glint-Horn while attacking and discard a card
perform state-based actions and terminal short-circuit
preconditions: Curiosity is attached to an attacking Glint-Horn and all three opponents are at one life.
required_assertions: a nonattacking Glint-Horn activation is rejected atomically
all three opponents lose for life total
waiting Curiosity triggers are retired and cleared
no CARD_DRAWN event occurs after lethal damage

plain_english: Curiosity is attached to an attacking Glint-Horn, and the same activation is rejected atomically when Glint-Horn is not attacking.
Discard-trigger damage reduces all three opponents to zero and triggers Curiosity once for each damaged opponent.
State-based actions and terminal processing clear those waiting optional draws before they can be put on the stack, so no card is drawn after the game ends.
title: Glint-Horn plus Curiosity eliminates the table before optional draws
